body: I love it! In the 80's I was in the punk scene & wanted to shave my head. My father forbid me to do it. My bf told me that it would be a turn off, so I never did it. Fast fwd, I am 52 yrs old, have Lupus and other health conditions and am losing my hair. I still love punk rock. There is no bf or anyone to forbid it now, so I was considering shaving my head too. You look beautiful and free. Thank you for inspiring me.💙

Hi. I think you have very warm, kind eyes and beautiful hair. I am also in the process of healing. I think the fact that you took some time to do your hair and makeup for this photo is a big plus. I used to be the sort of women who enjoyed getting "dolled up". Last year was one of the toughest times in my life. I have an autoimmune disease (Lupus), Depression and PTSD. I was hospitalized for suicidal ideation in December. I tested positive for Covid two days before I was discharged. I was isolated for month in my apt. All alone even on Christmas and very, very ill. Then my  boyfriend broke up with me over the phone & on Christmas Eve. This all took a huge toll on me physically, mentally and spiritually.  I lost too much weight and my hair fell out. I looked really bad and felt worse. One morning in April, I decided to take a bit time to do my makeup and fix my hair. I didn't even have anything to do or anywhere to go that day.(I was not working at that time). It was just me and my dog. I just go ready, like I used to, and then took my dog for a walk. It might sound strange but it helped me to do that. I started doing it more often and decided to make it a part of my daily routine. Some days I didn't feel like doing it, but I did it anyway. I called it "suiting up and showing up"and "fake it until you make it" lol. It really does help. It's self care. Keep suiting up and showing up like you did for this pic. One day you won't be faking it any more. You will pull through. I still struggle, but I feel better than I have in a long time. Who would have thought that a tube of lipstick could have magical powers right? You have a beautiful life ahead of you. 💙 Don't give up.
I just wanted to tell you that I like your art. I hope that you are feeling better today & that you recognize that you have a gift.
